primary_text: Hokas and running sneakers are engineered to bounce a runner forward on short runs. But when you are standing still on concrete waiting 70 minutes for an attraction, that bouncy foam compresses completely flat. That is why your feet feel completely exhausted before dinner. Comfort Wear Ortho Stretch shoes are built specifically for walking and prolonged standing: anatomical arch support that holds its shape under continuous body weight, a roomy toe box so your toes can relax and spread, and ultra-breathable stretch knit that keeps feet cool all day.
